documentation_excerpts.text: Scores one instruction file per dimension and turns that score into a CI gate.
`uv` on PATH (it provides `uvx`). No API key. Expects an instruction-file path for most commands; see each command's `--help`.
These run anywhere `uv` is available: no plugin, no checkout. All except `badge` and `demo` accept `--json` for machine-readable output.
